_about: Short lines a companion says during battle to teach the rules. The engine (src/combat/CombatTips.cpp) decides when a tip is due: at most once per campaign, the first time its 'when' holds on one of its 'maps' (campaign map ids) while its speaker is fighting and standing; Godot only shows it. 'when' is one of the keys in when_keys; nothing else is read. Checked by scripts/chapter1_story.py. Optional fields: 'reply' (0-2 lines [{speaker, text}], a second voice answers), 'repeat' ('campaign' default, or 'battle': once per battle), 'actor' (unit id or name; rushes, obstacle_broken, first_turn_shooter, defend_available), 'kind' (obstacle kind; obstacle_broken only). The first due tip in file order wins, one per turn.

when_keys.first_turn_shooter: a player stack with shots left takes its turn
when_keys.enemy_adjacent: an enemy stack stands next to one of the player's stacks
when_keys.flanked: a player stack has enemies on two opposite sides (pinned)
when_keys.low_stack: a player stack is below a quarter of the count it started the battle with
when_keys.defend_available: the first time the player could choose Defend
when_keys.victory_first: after the first battle the player wins
when_keys.rushes: a player stack's turn just ended: it walked, stands next to a living enemy, and no other living player stack is within 2 hexes (mad turns excluded)
when_keys.obstacle_broken: a player stack's blow destroyed an obstacle that turn

tips.speaker: Drest
tips.text: Your brother would have done that. Don't.

tips.speaker: Drest
tips.text: Keep me next to whoever takes the first blow, boy. Men stand steadier with me beside them.

tips.speaker: Drest
tips.text: Let the slingers throw while the field is open. Once something is at their throats they can't sling, and they fight badly hand to hand.

tips.speaker: Drest
tips.text: Whatever you hit hits back, but only once a round. Send the cheap blades in first; the good ones strike after.

tips.speaker: Drest
tips.text: They're on both sides of you. Pinned men can't strike back, and every blow bites deeper. Get out, then do it to them.

tips.speaker: Drest
tips.text: Those few won't win it. Pull them back behind the others before you lose them all.

tips.speaker: Drest
tips.text: Nothing worth hitting? Then defend. They hold their guard until their next turn.

tips.speaker: Drest
tips.text: Not bad, boy. Remember: Woad Runners and Painted Blades hit hardest with no friend at their elbow.

tips.speaker: Drest
tips.text: Mind the ones with names, boy. You can raise more slingers. You can't raise another of us.
